recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if OO explicitly decides that, after the FHIR-32788 simplification, the panel paragraph must separately repeat "arterial" in addition to the existing row and component labels.
issue_request: FHIR-25191 was an Applied/Persuasive OO change request for FHIR-core Observation, raised in STU3 and applied for R6. It asked to clarify the Vital Signs narrative that blood pressure vital-sign entries mean arterial blood pressure rather than venous pressure.
initial_application: Commit c6455a91d66110ba0f8ecc239d16447908cd4ffa, "Added 'arterial' to requested areas," references FHIR-25191 and added arterial wording to the blood pressure panel, systolic BP, and diastolic BP entries in source/observation/observation-vitalsigns-profile-introduction.xml. Jira also records PR #3669 for the application.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini, the Observation packs list includes ImplementationGuide/Observation-vitalsigns, and that implementation guide references both observation-vitalsigns-profile-introduction.xml and StructureDefinition/bp. Current BP profile/value set descriptions are also arterial. A later FHIR-32788 reconciliation commit removed supplemental blood pressure code guidance from the same row but preserved the arterial clarification, explaining the current paragraph's difference from the older FHIR-25191 resolution text.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current build input already conveys the approved arterial BP clarification. Adding another occurrence of "arterial" to the panel parenthetical would be redundant beside the arterial panel label and arterial component rows.

related_jiras.note: A later same-table-row cleanup removed supplemental blood pressure code guidance while leaving the FHIR-25191 arterial clarification intact; it is already represented on the combined branch.
